question: In the carbide slag-assisted steam gasification of sewage sludge, what apparent retention rate did Cr have at Ca/C = 0?
rendered:
Carbide Slag-Assisted Steam Gasification of Sewage Sludge for Hydrogen-Rich Syngas Production and Heavy Metal Stabilization, page 6

The apparent retention rate of Cr under Ca/C = 0 was 92.19%.
